semantics: complete_datagram notes DATA sent after full successful UDP send; success is kernel acceptance, not observed egress/delivery
unique_received counts accepted in-order/out-of-order receive insertion plus accepted FEC supply; nonunique source observations can still increment data_received
aggregate drop paths overlap sent/received and undecrypt counters; never sum or subtract as exclusive path losses
close/broken state and later old-flow hook observations alone do not uniquely identify qdisc/neighbor/provider-close-drain cause
